lede: The biggest item this week is the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave, where HARC holds three separate Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings Tuesday on Buildings A through E — new construction in an Accommodations 2 zone that will reshape a significant piece of the west end. Also Tuesday, HARC takes up accessibility renovations at Town Hall and a floor-area addition at the Parks & Rec office, while Wednesday's county Land Use Code working session digs into zoning, density, and regulatory incentives aimed at making workforce housing easier to build.

notable.stake: Public hearings on major multi-building Carhenge redevelopment in Accommodations 2 zone.
HARC reviews alterations to two Town-owned landmarks, including a floor-area increase.
County LUC rewrite targets zoning and density rules that govern affordable housing construction.
